description: Record 1-100 usage events in one all-or-nothing batch (POST /api/v1/usage). Every event MUST carry its own idempotency_key; retrying with the same keys is safe (results say created / duplicate / conflict). Needs your API key.

idempotency_key.description: Required. A stable id for this event (e.g. sha256 of run_id:step:tool_call_id, or your provider response id). Reuse it on retries: same key + same payload returns duplicate and counts once; same key + different payload is a conflict and the original is kept.

meter.description: Meter key or id. Optional only if the account has exactly one meter.

properties.description: Optional JSON stored with the event, e.g. {"traffic_class":"ai_agent","tool":"search"}.

subscription.description: Required. Your customer or subscription id (who to bill).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 or unix seconds/ms. Defaults to now. Max 30 days old, max 5 minutes in the future.

unique_value.description: Required for unique_count meters (e.g. a user id).

value.description: Required for sum meters (e.g. tokens). Defaults to 1 for count meters.

name: record_usage_events
title: Record usage events
